text:
1986 FIFA World Cup no kɔɔ Mexico nyinaa mu fi 31 May kɔsi 29 June, ɛyɛ ɔman a ɛdi kan a ɛhyɛɛ tɔnament no mmɔho mmienu wɔ 1970 edition a wɔyɛe no akyi. Mexico hyɛɛ mu bere a original hosts Colombia withdrawii. Teams 24 na wɔbɔɔ mu, wɔkyekyee mu kɔɔ groups six a ɛwɔ teams four mu; top two from each group, ne third-placed sides a ɛyɛ best four no, kɔɔ 16-team knockout phase. Eyi ne World Cup a edi kan a wɔde round of 16 format, a ɛdi akyi quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place match, ne final. Matches no kɔɔ high altitude ne heat mu, bi kɔɔ noon local time sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yie ma European television audiences. Canada, Denmark, ne Iraq nyinaa yɛɛ wɔn tournament debut. Total attendance kɔɔ 2,394,031 wɔ matches 52 mu, average bɛyɛ 46,039 per match.

Tɔnament no yɛ Diego Maradona dea, ɔno na ɔyɛ captain na ɔde Argentina kɔɔ title no mu wɔ nea wɔka sɛ ɛyɛ individual World Cup campaign a ɛsen biara. Wɔ quarter-final a ɛwɔ England no mu no ɔscoo ‘Hand of God’ goal a ɔde ne nsa bɔɔ mu nanso officials anhunu, na minutes kakra akyi ɔscoo ‘Goal of the Century’, ɔde ball no twaa England players bebree fi ne half no mu. Wɔ tɔnament no nyinaa mu Maradona scoo goals five na ɔde assists five, ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ goals 10 mu wɔ Argentina goals 14 mu, na ɔnyaa Golden Ball sɛ ɔyɛ player a ɛyɛ yie.

France a Michel Platini di wɔn anim no twaa Italy a wɔyɛ reigning holders no 2–0 wɔ round of 16 mu, na wɔtwam Brazil so wɔ penalties (4–3) akyi 1–1 draw, ansa na wɔatwa West Germany so wɔ semi-final mu na wɔagye third place. Belgium kɔɔ semi-finals no mu ne mprempren, na wɔgyee fourth place.

Final a ɛkɔɔ Estadio Azteca wɔ Mexico City no mu wɔ 29 June no, Argentina ne West Germany hyiae. José Luis Brown hyɛɛ scoring no wɔ 23rd minute na Jorge Valdano kaa second no wɔ 56th minute. West Germany san bɔɔ mu wɔ Karl-Heinz Rummenigge (74') ne Rudi Völler (81') so, nanso Jorge Burruchaga scoo winner no wɔ 84th minute fi Maradona pass. Argentina dii 3–2 wɔ normal time mu na wɔgyee world title a ɛdi mmienu, akyi 1978. Gary Lineker a ɔfiri England na ɔyɛ tournament top scorer wɔ goals six.
